label: Basic
description: Basic command list. Best for an always open list on a card, with a disabled Calculator row and shortcut hints on the Settings rows only.

label: Shortcuts
description: Command palette with shortcuts. Best for the smallest palette, a single Settings group of 3 rows with a shortcut on each, in a sheet.

label: Groups
description: Command palette with groups. Best for a palette with 2 groups, Suggestions as plain rows and Settings rows with shortcuts.

label: Many Groups
description: Command palette with many groups. Best for a dense palette of 5 groups and 23 rows, from navigation and file actions to view, account and tools.

label: File Search
description: File search palette. Best for a file finder whose rows show a name, a muted path and a type badge, opened from a Search files button.

label: User Search
description: People search with avatars. Best for a people search with an avatar, a name over an email, and a role badge tinted per Admin, Editor or Viewer.

label: Action Palette
description: Action palette with keyboard shortcuts. Best for verbs grouped as Create, Navigate and System, from New project and Invite member to dark mode and sign out.

label: Recent & Favorites
description: Recent and favourites. Best for a jump list of starred favourites, recent pages stamped 2m to 2h ago and help links, opened from a Search button.
